column1: # Production's answers for src/ng/paralog/production_parity.rs — frozen at promotion plan step C4.
# Every value below was computed by production's paralog filter — src/paralog/ and
# src/var_calling/paralog_filter/calibrate.rs — at commit d9e7b076, on the inputs the named
# test in production_parity.rs builds, by that test instrumented to write out what production
# returned. ng's copy agreed with each value at that commit, within the tolerances the test states.
# Format: one `key<TAB>value` per line. The key's first segment names the test's section.
# An f64 is its IEEE-754 bit pattern as 16 hex digits, so NaN and -0.0 survive; an Option<f64>
# is that or `none`; counts are decimal; booleans are `true`/`false`. A probe ratio or target
# in a key is written with Rust's `{:?}`.
